properties.description: As built 2026-09-19: build.rs embeds getting-started/POINTER.md as POINTER; skills::instruction_sections() serves it as section `pointer` (in the manifest, fetchable by name); genesis gains step 0 and adopt's Phase 0 bullet gains the no-instruction-file branch (init when the kit is present, else write the served pointer, then register). Test in tests/served_skills.rs.
properties.name: The pointer is served as a get_instructions section and genesis and adopt say when and how to leave the adapter in place
